questions.topicTag: Indian Geography: 19. Silk — Silk Production in India
questions.questionTextEn: Which state is the largest ‘silk’ producing state ?
questions.questionTextHi: [Chhattisgarh P.C.S. (Pre) 2005] Which state is the largest ‘silk’ producing state ?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (C) Karnataka. According to year 2021-22 data, Karnataka is the leading producer of mulberry silk, with 42.75% of the total mulberry silk production of the country. This is notable that out of total raw silk production in the country 32.33% is produced by the State of Karnataka. [Chhattisgarh P.C.S. (Pre) 2005]

questions.questionTextEn: More than three-fourths of India's production of raw silk comes from –
questions.questionTextHi: [U.P.P.C.S. (Mains) 2006] More than three-fourths of India's production of raw silk comes from –
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (A) Andhra Pradesh and Karnataka. When the question was asked three- fourth of India’s total raw silk production came from Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh. questions.topicTag: Indian Geography: 19. Silk — Silk Production in India
questions.questionTextEn: The discovery of Oak flora in 1966 added a new chapter to the history of Indian Sericulture. Which one of the following states is the leading producer of Oak Tasar silk?
questions.questionTextHi: [I.A.S. (Pre) 1998] The discovery of Oak flora in 1966 added a new chapter to the history of Indian Sericulture. Which one of the following states is the leading producer of Oak Tasar silk?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (C) Manipur. Jharkhand is currently the leading State to produce tasar silk in India. Tasar silk is divided into two categories namely tropical tasar and Oak tasar. Tropical tasar is produced the maximum in Jharkhand while Oak tasar is produced in Manipur. [I.A.S. (Pre) 1998]
